title: Reuse Judgment evaluations that cite imported evidence consumption
outcome: Valid native Judgment citations remain reusable after evidence exchange with their qualified provenance intact.
acceptance: A native passing unbound Judgment evaluation citing imported_evidence_consumption can be retained, associated and consumed after exchange when its full qualified history and governing/source requirements hold.
A behavioral round-trip test covers that citation and preserves refusal for missing or invalid provenance, closure or run membership; original records remain unchanged.

completion.summary: A native passing unbound Judgment evaluation that cites imported_evidence_consumption is now reusable after exchange. assess_citations routes it to imported::judgment, which checks the record's schema, identity, project, run and work membership, source, governing fingerprint and same_governing. It also checks provenance by proof kind: candidate_in_context for Verification, and a retained, unrefused, matching use decision for Acceptance. Test consumption::judgment::a_judged_pass_citing_an_imported_consumption_is_reused_after_exchange covers four cases: valid (associated, eligible, then consumed, store healthy); missing provenance; another run; and a cut from another origin. Each refused case records ineligible with CitationIneligible, or refuses and leaves the store unchanged. The consumption bytes stay unchanged. Candidate a4d31245dfc158af9a2296b282c945c788f3446a, packaged with w-8fb0c128e033. DL560 GO-S4-8FB0-2: red 9dcb3428 failed at the valid case as expected; clippy, task_sync::evidence 116/116 and acceptance_evaluation 257/257 passed. The independent evaluation (attempt 2) passed 2/2.
